violations.text: The food in the prep unit was observed held above 41 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Food in the unit for greater than 4 hours was voluntarily disposed of. Food that was recently moved to prep unit was relocated. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026

The prep unit was observed unable to hold food at an adequate temperature. Ambient temperature was 50 degrees. Unit use was discontinued, service ticket was placed at the time of inspection. Unit to not be used until able to maintain at adequate temperature throughout the day. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of bio-film. Unit to be cleaned and sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair. The drive thru lowboy door gasket was not tightly sealing. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2024
